description:
Free to download. Reminders, alarms, records, and widgets are free, with no limit on items. No account, no ads, and nothing to set up first: open Maru, add your first item, and go.

Did I take it? Open Maru and you know.

Maru reminds you to take your vitamins, supplements, and medicine. One tap records each dose.

Your items and records stay on your iPhone or iPad. You need no account, and Maru sends nothing about what you take.

ONE LOOK
• Today shows what to take now and what you took already.
• Widgets on your Home Screen and Lock Screen show your day, your next dose, and your last dose.
• History shows months at a glance, and the last 7 days of each item.
• For an as-needed item, Today shows the last dose and its amount.

ONE TAP
• Tap the circle beside an item to record it.
• Record from the reminder and leave the app closed: "Taken", "Skip", or "Remind in 10 min".
• Wrong tap? Undo it, or change the time.
• Not today? Tap "Skip", and Maru keeps that too. In History, you can mark a past dose with no record as "Skipped".

A REMINDER, OR AN ALARM
• Choose for each item: a quiet reminder, or an alarm that rings like the Clock app. Alarms need iOS 26 or later.
• Turn on "Remind Again", and Maru sends up to 12 more reminders for a dose that you did not record.
• Set times daily, every other day, every few days, or for days on and days off, such as 21 days on and 7 off. Record as-needed items without reminders.
• A reminder says what to take. One switch hides the names.

FOR SUPPLEMENTS AND MEDICINE
• "Scan Label": point the camera at the bottle, and your iPhone or iPad reads the name. No photo is saved or sent.
• Adding an item is short: a name, a plan, and a reminder. Amount, look, and note wait under "More Options". You choose them. Maru chooses no dose for you.
• Give an item a photo, and you know it at a glance.

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
• Optional usage counts never include what you take. One switch in Settings turns them off.
• Your file, your choice: "Export Records" makes a CSV file. You choose where it goes.
• "Back Up" and "Restore from Backup" move you to a new iPhone or iPad.

MARU PRO
Everything above is free. Maru Pro is optional, and it adds:
• "Next Dose on Lock Screen": your next dose stays on the Lock Screen, with a "Taken" button.
• An Apple Watch app: see your doses and record them from your wrist.
• Reports for your doctor: "Share Medication List" and "Share Summary" make a PDF. Each item also shows its counts for the last 30 days.
• Family: add a person or a pet, such as a parent or your dog. Each one has a color, and Today, History, and the PDF can show one of them. All data stays on your iPhone, with no shared profiles and no sync.
• Make Maru yours: app icons, reminder sounds, and app colors.
Choose a yearly plan with a 7-day free trial, or pay once for lifetime access. Family Sharing is on. The yearly plan renews each year until you cancel it in the settings of your Apple Account.

SMALL ANSWERS
• Dark mode? Yes. Maru follows your iPhone.
• iPad? Yes. Each device keeps its own data, and Maru does not sync between them.
• Internet? Maru works without it.

NO STREAKS
Forgot to record? Nothing happens. Maru has no streaks and no penalties.

Maru gives no medical advice. Silent mode or a Focus can hold a reminder. Ask your doctor or pharmacist about what you take.

whatsNew:
The first release of Maru.
• Reminders at your times, or an alarm that rings like the Clock app (iOS 26 or later).
• Record from the reminder: "Taken", "Take All", "Skip", "Skip All", or "Remind in 10 min".
• "Remind Again" for each item, or for all items at once in Settings.
• Today, History, and widgets for the Home Screen and the Lock Screen.
• "Export Records", "Back Up", and "Restore from Backup".
• Maru Pro: the next dose on the Lock Screen, Apple Watch, PDF reports, 30-day counts, Family, and more icons, sounds, and colors.
• "Language" in Settings, and "Delete Item" in the menu when you touch and hold an item.
